"""
Mei TUI — main agent harness.

Run with:  py -m Mei.cli.tui
Or via:    py app.py

Layout:
  ┌─ PIPELINE ──┬─ TRACE ────────┐
  │             │                │
  ├─ MODELS ────┼─ MEMORY ───────┤
  │             │                │
  └─────────────┴─ INPUT ────────┘
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import logging
import queue
import shutil
import sys
import threading
import time
import traceback
from typing import Optional

from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.widgets import Input, Footer, Header

from ..core.events import EventType, subscribe, emit, get_event_bus
from ..core.cancellation import get_cancellation_token
from .event_bridge import get_event_bridge, AgentEvent
from .widgets import PipelinePane, TracePane, ModelPane, MemoryPane


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Print capture — redirects sys.stdout + sys.stderr into the trace pane
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TUIPrintCapture(io.TextIOBase):
    """
    Replaces sys.stdout and sys.stderr.
    Buffers partial writes until a newline, then posts the complete line
    to the trace pane via the TUI's message queue.

    Also handles native-C library output note: llama.cpp writes to C-level
    fd 1/2 directly — those bypass this wrapper. Silence them via the
    library's verbose=False flag (already set in engine.py).
    """

    def __init__(self, app: "MeiTUI") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._app = app
        self._buf = ""

    def write(self, text: str) -> int:
        self._buf += text
        while "\n" in self._buf:
            line, self._buf = self._buf.split("\n", 1)
            if line:
                self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(line))
        return len(text)

    def flush(self) -> None:
        if self._buf:
            self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(self._buf))
            self._buf = ""

    def fileno(self) -> int:
        # Some libraries call fileno() to check if this is a real file.
        # Return the original fd so they can fall back gracefully.
        return 1


class TUILoggingHandler(logging.Handler):
    """Routes logging records into the trace pane."""

    def __init__(self, app: "MeiTUI") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._app = app

    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:  # noqa: A003
        try:
            msg = self.format(record)
            self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(msg))
        except Exception:
            pass


class AgentPrint(AgentEvent.__class__.__bases__[0]):  # Message
    """Carries a single line of print() or logging output to the TUI."""
    from textual.message import Message as _M
    pass


# Re-define properly since we can't inherit from AgentEvent indirectly
from textual.message import Message as _TMessage

class AgentPrint(_TMessage):
    def __init__(self, line: str) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.line = line


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Main TUI Application
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class MeiTUI(App):
    """Mei agent harness TUI."""

    CSS_PATH = "tui.tcss"
    TITLE = "Mei Agent"
    SUB_TITLE = "v0.1"

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel_execution", "Cancel", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+q", "quit", "Quit", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+l", "clear_trace", "Clear trace", show=True),
    ]

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Print capture — set before compose so early prints go to trace
        self._original_stdout = sys.stdout
        self._original_stderr = sys.stderr
        self._logging_handler: Optional[TUILoggingHandler] = None

        # Command queue — single worker serializes all commands
        self._cmd_queue: queue.Queue = queue.Queue()
        self._worker: Optional[threading.Thread] = None

        # Teaching mode state
        self._teaching_name: Optional[str] = None
        self._teaching_steps: list = []
        self._teaching_subscriber = None

    # ── Composition ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        from textual.containers import Grid
        with Grid(id="main-grid"):
            yield PipelinePane(id="pipeline-pane")
            yield TracePane(id="trace-pane")
            yield ModelPane(id="model-pane")
            yield MemoryPane(id="memory-pane")
        yield Input(placeholder="> Type a command or /help ...", id="cmd-input")
        yield Footer()

    # ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        # 1. Redirect print() output to trace pane
        capture = TUIPrintCapture(self)
        sys.stdout = capture
        sys.stderr = capture

        # 2. Redirect logging
        self._logging_handler = TUILoggingHandler(self)
        self._logging_handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("[%(name)s] %(message)s"))
        logging.root.addHandler(self._logging_handler)

        # 3. Attach event bridge (agent EventBus → TUI messages)
        get_event_bridge().attach(self)

        # 4. Bootstrap agent
        self._bootstrap_agent()

        # 5. Start single worker thread
        self._start_worker()

        # 6. Log startup
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write("[bold green]Mei TUI started.[/bold green]  Type a command or [bold]/help[/bold]")

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        # Restore stdout/stderr
        sys.stdout = self._original_stdout
        sys.stderr = self._original_stderr
        if self._logging_handler:
            logging.root.removeHandler(self._logging_handler)
        # Stop worker
        self._cmd_queue.put(None)

    def _bootstrap_agent(self) -> None:
        """Initialize all agent components."""
        from ..core.config import init_config
        from ..action.executor import get_executor
        from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
        from ..core.pipeline import start_pipeline

        init_config()
        get_working_memory()
        get_executor()
        emit(EventType.AGENT_STARTED, source="MeiTUI")
        start_pipeline()

    # ── Worker thread ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _start_worker(self) -> None:
        self._worker = threading.Thread(
            target=self._agent_worker, daemon=True, name="MeiWorker"
        )
        self._worker.start()

    def _agent_worker(self) -> None:
        """
        Single long-lived worker thread.
        Serializes all commands — no overlap possible.
        Catches all exceptions and keeps the TUI alive.
        """
        from ..core.pipeline import process_user_command
        from ..action.context import ExecutionContext

        while True:
            cmd = self._cmd_queue.get()
            if cmd is None:  # shutdown signal
                break

            try:
                get_cancellation_token().reset()  # reset flag for each new command
                ctx = ExecutionContext.empty()
                from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
                session_id = get_working_memory()._session_id
                if session_id:
                    ctx.set_variable("session_id", session_id)
                process_user_command(cmd, ctx)
            except Exception:
                tb = traceback.format_exc()
                emit(EventType.ERROR, source="Worker", error=tb)
                # Worker stays alive — ready for next command

    # ── Print capture handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_agent_print(self, msg: AgentPrint) -> None:
        try:
            trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
            trace.write_agent_print(msg.line)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ── Input handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_input_submitted(self, event: Input.Submitted) -> None:
        text = event.value.strip()
        event.input.value = ""

        if not text:
            return

        if text.startswith("/"):
            self._handle_slash(text)
        else:
            # Regular command — enqueue for worker
            if self._worker and not self._worker.is_alive():
                self._show_error("Worker crashed. Use /restart to recover.")
                return
            self._cmd_queue.put(text)

    def _handle_slash(self, cmd: str) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        parts = cmd.split(None, 1)
        verb = parts[0].lower()
        arg = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""

        if verb == "/help":
            trace.write(
                "[bold]Commands:[/bold]\n"
                "  /teach <name>   Start recording a workflow\n"
                "  /done           Stop recording and save\n"
                "  /query <cypher> Run a Kùzu query (live)\n"
                "  /tools          List registered tools\n"
                "  /memory         Show memory stats\n"
                "  /wipe           Wipe the Kùzu database\n"
                "  /restart        Restart the agent worker\n"
                "  /status         Refresh all panes\n"
                "  /clear          Clear the trace pane\n"
                "  Esc             Cancel current execution\n"
                "  Ctrl+Q          Quit"
            )

        elif verb == "/teach":
            if not arg:
                trace.write("[red]Usage: /teach <workflow name>[/red]")
            elif self._teaching_name is not None:
                trace.write(f"[yellow]Already recording '{self._teaching_name}'. Use /done first.[/yellow]")
            else:
                self._start_teaching(arg)

        elif verb == "/done":
            if self._teaching_name is None:
                trace.write("[yellow]/done has no effect — not currently recording.[/yellow]")
            elif len(self._teaching_steps) == 0:
                trace.write("[yellow]No steps recorded. Demonstrate some actions first.[/yellow]")
            else:
                # Route through worker to avoid concurrent Kùzu writes
                self._cmd_queue.put(("__teach_save__", self._teaching_name, list(self._teaching_steps)))
                self._stop_teaching()

        elif verb == "/query":
            if not arg:
                trace.write("[red]Usage: /query <cypher>[/red]")
            else:
                self._run_query(arg)

        elif verb == "/tools":
            from ..action.executor import get_executor
            tools = get_executor().list_actions()
            trace.write("[bold]Registered tools:[/bold]  " + "  ".join(tools))

        elif verb == "/memory":
            self._show_memory_stats()

        elif verb == "/wipe":
            self._confirm_wipe()

        elif verb == "/restart":
            self._restart_worker()

        elif verb in ("/status", "/refresh"):
            pass  # panes auto-update from events; this is a no-op refresh

        elif verb in ("/clear", "/cl"):
            trace.clear()

        else:
            trace.write(f"[red]Unknown command: {cmd}[/red]  Type [bold]/help[/bold] for a list.")

    # ── Teaching mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _start_teaching(self, name: str) -> None:
        self._teaching_name = name
        self._teaching_steps = []

        def _capture(event):
            self._teaching_steps.append({
                "action": event.data.get("action"),
                "parameters": event.data.get("parameters", {}),
            })

        self._teaching_subscriber = _capture
        subscribe(EventType.PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED, _capture)

        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write(
            f"[yellow bold]● REC[/yellow bold]  Recording [bold]{name!r}[/bold] — "
            "demonstrate the workflow, then type [bold]/done[/bold]"
        )

    def _stop_teaching(self) -> None:
        if self._teaching_subscriber is not None:
            get_event_bus().unsubscribe(EventType.PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED, self._teaching_subscriber)
            self._teaching_subscriber = None
        self._teaching_name = None
        self._teaching_steps = []

    # The actual save runs inside the worker (enqueued above) to avoid
    # concurrent Kùzu writes with the agent thread.

    # ── Live Kùzu query ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _run_query(self, cypher: str) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import get_kuzu_connection
            conn = get_kuzu_connection()
            rows = conn.execute(cypher)
            if not rows:
                trace.write("[dim](no results)[/dim]")
                return
            from rich.table import Table
            from rich.markup import escape
            table = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold cyan", box=None)
            for col in rows[0].keys():
                table.add_column(str(col))
            for row in rows[:50]:  # cap at 50 rows in trace
                table.add_row(*[escape(str(v)) for v in row.values()])
            trace.write(table)
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Query error: {e}[/red]")

    # ── Memory stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _show_memory_stats(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import get_kuzu_connection
            conn = get_kuzu_connection()
            stats = {}
            for table, label in [
                ("Goal", "Goals"), ("Action", "Actions"),
                ("Session", "Sessions"), ("ElementCache", "Elements"),
                ("Preference", "Preferences"),
            ]:
                try:
                    rows = conn.execute(f"MATCH (n:{table}) RETURN count(n) AS c")
                    stats[label] = rows[0]["c"] if rows else 0
                except Exception:
                    stats[label] = "?"
            line = "  ".join(f"[bold]{v}[/bold] {k}" for k, v in stats.items())
            trace.write(f"[cyan]Memory:[/cyan]  {line}")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Memory stats error: {e}[/red]")

    # ── Wipe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _confirm_wipe(self) -> None:
        from textual.screen import ModalScreen
        from textual.widgets import Button, Label
        from textual.containers import Vertical

        class WipeConfirm(ModalScreen):
            def compose(self):
                with Vertical(id="dialog"):
                    yield Label("⚠  Wipe the entire Kùzu database?\nThis cannot be undone.", id="q")
                    yield Button("Yes, wipe", variant="error", id="yes")
                    yield Button("Cancel", variant="primary", id="no")

            def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
                self.dismiss(event.button.id == "yes")

        def _after(confirmed: bool) -> None:
            if confirmed:
                self._do_wipe()

        self.push_screen(WipeConfirm(), _after)

    def _do_wipe(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)

        # 1. Cancel any running execution
        get_cancellation_token().cancel()

        # 2. Guard: check worker is not busy
        if self._worker and self._worker.is_alive():
            # Clear the queue and send shutdown sentinel
            try:
                while True:
                    self._cmd_queue.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                pass
            self._cmd_queue.put(None)
            self._worker.join(timeout=1.0)

            if self._worker.is_alive():
                trace.write(
                    "[red]Worker is still running (stuck in LLM call).[/red]  "
                    "Cancel first with [bold]Esc[/bold], then retry /wipe."
                )
                return

        # 3. Close Kùzu Database object (not just connection)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import KuzuConnection
            KuzuConnection._instance = None  # allow GC to close the DB
            import gc; gc.collect()
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[yellow]Warning: could not close Kùzu cleanly: {e}[/yellow]")

        # 4. Delete the DB directory
        from ..core.config import get_config
        db_path = get_config().kuzu.database_path
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(db_path, ignore_errors=True)
            trace.write(f"[green]Wiped {db_path}[/green]")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Failed to delete {db_path}: {e}[/red]")
            return

        # 5. Re-bootstrap Kùzu
        try:
            from ..memory.graph import _bootstrap
            _bootstrap()
            trace.write("[green]Kùzu re-initialized.[/green]")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Re-bootstrap failed: {e}[/red]")

        # 6. Start fresh worker
        self._start_worker()

    # ── Restart worker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _restart_worker(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)

        if self._worker and self._worker.is_alive():
            trace.write(
                "[yellow]Worker is still running.[/yellow]  "
                "Press [bold]Esc[/bold] to cancel, then retry [bold]/restart[/bold]."
            )
            return

        trace.write("[cyan]Restarting agent worker...[/cyan]")
        self._start_worker()
        trace.write("[green]Worker restarted.[/green]")

    # ── Actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_cancel_execution(self) -> None:
        """Escape — soft-cancel current execution."""
        get_cancellation_token().cancel()
        pipeline_pane = self.query_one(PipelinePane)
        pipeline_pane._status = "CANCELLING"
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write("[yellow]◼ Cancelling...[/yellow]")

    def action_clear_trace(self) -> None:
        self.query_one(TracePane).clear()

    def _show_error(self, msg: str) -> None:
        try:
            self.query_one(TracePane).write(f"[red]{msg}[/red]")
        except Exception:
            pass

    MeiTUI().run()

```python
"""
Mei Graph Inspector — standalone read-only Kùzu viewer.

Run with:  py -m Mei.cli.graph

This is a POST-MORTEM tool. It opens the Kùzu database in read-only mode.
While the agent is running and holds the write lock, this tool will show
a "DB locked" banner and retry on keypress.

For live inspection while the agent is running, use /query inside the TUI.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Optional

import kuzu
from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.widgets import (
    DataTable, Footer, Header, Static, TextArea, Tree
)
from textual.containers import Horizontal, Vertical

# Pull DB path from config rather than hardcoding it
def _db_path() -> str:
    try:
        from ..core.config import get_config
        return get_config().kuzu.database_path
    except Exception:
        return "data/kuzu_memory"


STARTER_QUERIES = [
    "MATCH (g:Goal) RETURN g.raw_command, g.stability_score, g.created_at ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (g:Goal)-[:ACHIEVED_BY]->(a:Action) RETURN g.raw_command, count(a) AS steps GROUP BY g.raw_command ORDER BY steps DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (p:Preference) RETURN p.pref_key, p.pref_value, p.category ORDER BY p.category",
    "MATCH (e:ElementCache) RETURN e.element_query, e.app_name, e.hit_count ORDER BY e.hit_count DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (s:Session) RETURN s.id, s.started_at, s.ended_at ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 10",
]


def _open_readonly() -> Optional[kuzu.Connection]:
    """
    Open the Kùzu database in read-only mode.
    Returns None if the file lock is held by the agent.
    """
    try:
        db = kuzu.Database(_db_path(), read_only=True)
        return kuzu.Connection(db)
    except Exception as e:
        if "lock" in str(e).lower() or "cannot set lock" in str(e).lower():
            return None
        raise


class MeiGraph(App):
    """Standalone Kùzu graph inspector."""

    TITLE = "Mei Graph Inspector"
    SUB_TITLE = _db_path()

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("r", "refresh", "Refresh", show=True),
        Binding("f5", "run_query", "Run query", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+q", "quit", "Quit", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    Screen { layout: vertical; }

    #top-row {
        height: 1fr;
        layout: horizontal;
    }

    #goal-tree {
        width: 40%;
        border: solid $primary;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    #right-col {
        width: 60%;
        layout: vertical;
    }

    #query-area {
        height: 8;
        border: solid $accent;
    }

    #results-table {
        height: 1fr;
        border: solid $primary;
    }

    #stats-bar {
        height: 1;
        background: $primary-darken-2;
        color: $text;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._conn: Optional[kuzu.Connection] = None
        self._locked = False

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        with Horizontal(id="top-row"):
            yield Tree("Goals", id="goal-tree")
            with Vertical(id="right-col"):
                yield TextArea(STARTER_QUERIES[0], id="query-area")
                yield DataTable(id="results-table")
        yield Static("", id="stats-bar")
        yield Footer()

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        results = self.query_one(DataTable)
        results.show_header = True
        self.action_refresh()

    # ── Refresh (tree + stats) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_refresh(self) -> None:
        """[r] Reopen DB, rebuild tree, update stats."""
        # Close previous connection and DB object
        if self._conn is not None:
            try:
                self._conn.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._conn = None

        self._conn = _open_readonly()
        stats_bar = self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static)

        if self._conn is None:
            self._locked = True
            stats_bar.update(
                "⚠  DB locked — agent is running.  "
                "Press [bold]r[/bold] to retry, or use [bold]/query[/bold] inside the TUI."
            )
            tree = self.query_one("#goal-tree", Tree)
            tree.clear()
            tree.root.add_leaf("(DB locked — agent holds write lock)")
            return

        self._locked = False
        self._rebuild_tree()
        self._refresh_stats()

    def _rebuild_tree(self) -> None:
        if self._conn is None:
            return

        tree = self.query_one("#goal-tree", Tree)
        tree.clear()

        try:
            rows = self._conn.execute("""
                MATCH (g:Goal)
                OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ACHIEVED_BY]->(first:Action)
                OPTIONAL MATCH p = (first)-[:NEXT_ACTION*0..20]->(a:Action)
                RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS gid, g.raw_command AS cmd,
                       g.stability_score AS stab, g.created_at AS ts,
                       a.tool_name AS tool, a.parameters_json AS params,
                       a.step_domain AS domain
                ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, length(p)
                LIMIT 100
            """)
        except Exception as e:
            tree.root.add_leaf(f"Query error: {e}")
            return

        # Group by goal
        goals: dict[str, dict] = {}
        goal_actions: dict[str, list] = {}

        for row in rows:
            gid = row.get("gid", "?")
            if gid not in goals:
                stab = row.get("stab")
                stab_str = f"{stab:.2f}" if stab is not None else "?"
                goals[gid] = {
                    "cmd": (row.get("cmd") or "")[:60],
                    "stab": stab_str,
                    "ts": (row.get("ts") or "")[:19],
                }
                goal_actions[gid] = []

            tool = row.get("tool")
            if tool:
                try:
                    params = json.loads(row.get("params") or "{}")
                except Exception:
                    params = {}
                goal_actions[gid].append((tool, params, row.get("domain", "")))

        # Build tree
        root = tree.root
        for gid, meta in goals.items():
            label = f"{meta['cmd']}  [stab={meta['stab']}]  {meta['ts']}"
            goal_node = root.add(label, expand=False)
            seen_tools = set()
            for tool, params, domain in goal_actions.get(gid, []):
                key = (tool, json.dumps(params, sort_keys=True))
                if key not in seen_tools:
                    seen_tools.add(key)
                    param_str = ", ".join(f"{k}={v!r}" for k, v in list(params.items())[:3])
                    goal_node.add_leaf(f"[{domain}] {tool}({param_str})")

    def _refresh_stats(self) -> None:
        if self._conn is None:
            return

        stats_bar = self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static)
        counts = {}
        for table, label in [
            ("Goal", "Goals"), ("Action", "Actions"),
            ("Session", "Sessions"), ("ElementCache", "Elements"),
            ("Preference", "Preferences"),
        ]:
            try:
                rows = self._conn.execute(f"MATCH (n:{table}) RETURN count(n) AS c")
                counts[label] = rows[0]["c"] if rows else 0
            except Exception:
                counts[label] = "?"

        line = "  │  ".join(f"{label}: {v}" for label, v in counts.items())
        stats_bar.update(f"  {line}  │  Press [r] refresh  [F5] run query  [Ctrl+Q] quit")

    # ── Query panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_run_query(self) -> None:
        """[F5] Execute the Cypher in the query area."""
        if self._locked or self._conn is None:
            self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static).update(
                "⚠  DB locked. Press [r] to retry."
            )
            return

        cypher = self.query_one("#query-area", TextArea).text.strip()
        if not cypher:
            return

        table = self.query_one("#results-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)

        try:
            rows = self._conn.execute(cypher)
        except Exception as e:
            table.add_columns("Error")
            table.add_row(str(e))
            return

        if not rows:
            table.add_columns("Result")
            table.add_row("(no results)")
            return

        cols = list(rows[0].keys())
        table.add_columns(*[str(c) for c in cols])
        for row in rows[:200]:  # cap display at 200 rows
            table.add_row(*[str(row.get(c, "")) for c in cols])


def main():
    MeiGraph().run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## Implementation Plan: Mei TUI + Graph Inspector

### Problem Statement
The current app.py is a blind terminal script — no visibility into what the agent is doing per-module, crashes take down everything, and there's no way to inspect Kùzu data without writing one-off scripts. This plan builds a proper agent harness: a live multi-pane TUI for running the agent, and a standalone graph inspector that can run in any separate terminal window.

### Key architectural decisions
- Graph inspector is a POST-MORTEM tool only — not live while agent runs (Kùzu file lock conflict). Live inspection uses `/query <cypher>` inside the main TUI through the agent's own connection.
- No queue/timer polling — use `post_message(AgentEvent)` from worker thread directly (thread-safe, zero latency).
- Single long-lived worker thread consuming a cmd_queue — no thread-per-command.
- Print capture redirects both sys.stdout and sys.stderr with line buffering + flush().
- CancellationToken uses threading.Event, binds to Escape (not Ctrl+C), resets on next command submission.

"""
Global soft-cancellation token for the MicroPlanner execution loop.

Usage:
    from Mei.core.cancellation import get_cancellation_token
    token = get_cancellation_token()
    token.cancel()   # from TUI Escape binding
    token.reset()    # called at start of each new command
    token.is_cancelled  # checked in MicroPlanner between steps
"""
import threading


class CancellationToken:
    """
    Thread-safe cancellation flag backed by threading.Event.
    Uses Event.is_set() — no hand-rolled lock needed.
    """
    def __init__(self):
        self._event = threading.Event()

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        """Signal cancellation. Checked by MicroPlanner before each step."""
        self._event.set()

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Clear the flag. Called when a new command is submitted."""
        self._event.clear()

    @property
    def is_cancelled(self) -> bool:
        return self._event.is_set()


_global_token = CancellationToken()


def get_cancellation_token() -> CancellationToken:
    """Return the process-global cancellation token."""
    return _global_token
```

"""
TUI Event Bridge — connects the agent's EventBus to the Textual app.

Uses post_message() (thread-safe Textual API) to push agent events
to the TUI without polling or queues.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from textual.message import Message

from ..core.events import get_event_bus, Event

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from textual.app import App


class AgentEvent(Message):
    """Wraps an agent Event for delivery to Textual widgets."""

    def __init__(self, event: Event) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.agent_event = event


class TUIEventBridge:
    """
    Subscribes to the global EventBus and posts each event to the
    Textual app via post_message() — which is thread-safe and requires
    no polling timer.

    Usage:
        bridge = get_event_bridge()
        bridge.attach(self)   # call from MeiTUI.on_mount
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self._app: App | None = None

    def attach(self, app: "App") -> None:
        """Call once from MeiTUI.on_mount after the app is running."""
        self._app = app
        get_event_bus().subscribe_all(self._on_event)

    def _on_event(self, event: Event) -> None:
        """Called from agent worker thread — posts to app's message queue."""
        if self._app is not None:
            try:
                self._app.post_message(AgentEvent(event))
            except Exception:
                pass  # app may be shutting down; ignore silently


_bridge = TUIEventBridge()


def get_event_bridge() -> TUIEventBridge:
    """Return the process-global event bridge."""
    return _bridge

"""
Mei TUI — main agent harness.

Run with:  py -m Mei.cli.tui
Or via:    py app.py

Layout:
  ┌─ PIPELINE ──┬─ TRACE ────────┐
  │             │                │
  ├─ MODELS ────┼─ MEMORY ───────┤
  │             │                │
  └─────────────┴─ INPUT ────────┘
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import io
import logging
import queue
import shutil
import sys
import threading
import time
import traceback
from typing import Optional

from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.widgets import Input, Footer, Header

from ..core.events import EventType, subscribe, emit, get_event_bus
from ..core.cancellation import get_cancellation_token
from .event_bridge import get_event_bridge, AgentEvent
from .widgets import PipelinePane, TracePane, ModelPane, MemoryPane


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Print capture — redirects sys.stdout + sys.stderr into the trace pane
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class TUIPrintCapture(io.TextIOBase):
    """
    Replaces sys.stdout and sys.stderr.
    Buffers partial writes until a newline, then posts the complete line
    to the trace pane via the TUI's message queue.

    Also handles native-C library output note: llama.cpp writes to C-level
    fd 1/2 directly — those bypass this wrapper. Silence them via the
    library's verbose=False flag (already set in engine.py).
    """

    def __init__(self, app: "MeiTUI") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._app = app
        self._buf = ""

    def write(self, text: str) -> int:
        self._buf += text
        while "\n" in self._buf:
            line, self._buf = self._buf.split("\n", 1)
            if line:
                self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(line))
        return len(text)

    def flush(self) -> None:
        if self._buf:
            self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(self._buf))
            self._buf = ""

    def fileno(self) -> int:
        # Some libraries call fileno() to check if this is a real file.
        # Return the original fd so they can fall back gracefully.
        return 1


class TUILoggingHandler(logging.Handler):
    """Routes logging records into the trace pane."""

    def __init__(self, app: "MeiTUI") -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self._app = app

    def emit(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> None:  # noqa: A003
        try:
            msg = self.format(record)
            self._app.post_message(AgentPrint(msg))
        except Exception:
            pass


class AgentPrint(AgentEvent.__class__.__bases__[0]):  # Message
    """Carries a single line of print() or logging output to the TUI."""
    from textual.message import Message as _M
    pass


# Re-define properly since we can't inherit from AgentEvent indirectly
from textual.message import Message as _TMessage

class AgentPrint(_TMessage):
    def __init__(self, line: str) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.line = line


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Main TUI Application
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class MeiTUI(App):
    """Mei agent harness TUI."""

    CSS_PATH = "tui.tcss"
    TITLE = "Mei Agent"
    SUB_TITLE = "v0.1"

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("escape", "cancel_execution", "Cancel", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+q", "quit", "Quit", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+l", "clear_trace", "Clear trace", show=True),
    ]

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Print capture — set before compose so early prints go to trace
        self._original_stdout = sys.stdout
        self._original_stderr = sys.stderr
        self._logging_handler: Optional[TUILoggingHandler] = None

        # Command queue — single worker serializes all commands
        self._cmd_queue: queue.Queue = queue.Queue()
        self._worker: Optional[threading.Thread] = None

        # Teaching mode state
        self._teaching_name: Optional[str] = None
        self._teaching_steps: list = []
        self._teaching_subscriber = None

    # ── Composition ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        from textual.containers import Grid
        with Grid(id="main-grid"):
            yield PipelinePane(id="pipeline-pane")
            yield TracePane(id="trace-pane")
            yield ModelPane(id="model-pane")
            yield MemoryPane(id="memory-pane")
        yield Input(placeholder="> Type a command or /help ...", id="cmd-input")
        yield Footer()

    # ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        # 1. Redirect print() output to trace pane
        capture = TUIPrintCapture(self)
        sys.stdout = capture
        sys.stderr = capture

        # 2. Redirect logging
        self._logging_handler = TUILoggingHandler(self)
        self._logging_handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("[%(name)s] %(message)s"))
        logging.root.addHandler(self._logging_handler)

        # 3. Attach event bridge (agent EventBus → TUI messages)
        get_event_bridge().attach(self)

        # 4. Bootstrap agent
        self._bootstrap_agent()

        # 5. Start single worker thread
        self._start_worker()

        # 6. Log startup
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write("[bold green]Mei TUI started.[/bold green]  Type a command or [bold]/help[/bold]")

    def on_unmount(self) -> None:
        # Restore stdout/stderr
        sys.stdout = self._original_stdout
        sys.stderr = self._original_stderr
        if self._logging_handler:
            logging.root.removeHandler(self._logging_handler)
        # Stop worker
        self._cmd_queue.put(None)

    def _bootstrap_agent(self) -> None:
        """Initialize all agent components."""
        from ..core.config import init_config
        from ..action.executor import get_executor
        from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
        from ..core.pipeline import start_pipeline

        init_config()
        get_working_memory()
        get_executor()
        emit(EventType.AGENT_STARTED, source="MeiTUI")
        start_pipeline()

    # ── Worker thread ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _start_worker(self) -> None:
        self._worker = threading.Thread(
            target=self._agent_worker, daemon=True, name="MeiWorker"
        )
        self._worker.start()

    def _agent_worker(self) -> None:
        """
        Single long-lived worker thread.
        Serializes all commands — no overlap possible.
        Catches all exceptions and keeps the TUI alive.
        """
        from ..core.pipeline import process_user_command
        from ..action.context import ExecutionContext

        while True:
            cmd = self._cmd_queue.get()
            if cmd is None:  # shutdown signal
                break

            try:
                get_cancellation_token().reset()  # reset flag for each new command
                ctx = ExecutionContext.empty()
                from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
                session_id = get_working_memory()._session_id
                if session_id:
                    ctx.set_variable("session_id", session_id)
                process_user_command(cmd, ctx)
            except Exception:
                tb = traceback.format_exc()
                emit(EventType.ERROR, source="Worker", error=tb)
                # Worker stays alive — ready for next command

    # ── Print capture handler ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_agent_print(self, msg: AgentPrint) -> None:
        try:
            trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
            trace.write_agent_print(msg.line)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ── Input handling ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def on_input_submitted(self, event: Input.Submitted) -> None:
        text = event.value.strip()
        event.input.value = ""

        if not text:
            return

        if text.startswith("/"):
            self._handle_slash(text)
        else:
            # Regular command — enqueue for worker
            if self._worker and not self._worker.is_alive():
                self._show_error("Worker crashed. Use /restart to recover.")
                return
            self._cmd_queue.put(text)

    def _handle_slash(self, cmd: str) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        parts = cmd.split(None, 1)
        verb = parts[0].lower()
        arg = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""

        if verb == "/help":
            trace.write(
                "[bold]Commands:[/bold]\n"
                "  /teach <name>   Start recording a workflow\n"
                "  /done           Stop recording and save\n"
                "  /query <cypher> Run a Kùzu query (live)\n"
                "  /tools          List registered tools\n"
                "  /memory         Show memory stats\n"
                "  /wipe           Wipe the Kùzu database\n"
                "  /restart        Restart the agent worker\n"
                "  /status         Refresh all panes\n"
                "  /clear          Clear the trace pane\n"
                "  Esc             Cancel current execution\n"
                "  Ctrl+Q          Quit"
            )

        elif verb == "/teach":
            if not arg:
                trace.write("[red]Usage: /teach <workflow name>[/red]")
            elif self._teaching_name is not None:
                trace.write(f"[yellow]Already recording '{self._teaching_name}'. Use /done first.[/yellow]")
            else:
                self._start_teaching(arg)

        elif verb == "/done":
            if self._teaching_name is None:
                trace.write("[yellow]/done has no effect — not currently recording.[/yellow]")
            elif len(self._teaching_steps) == 0:
                trace.write("[yellow]No steps recorded. Demonstrate some actions first.[/yellow]")
            else:
                # Route through worker to avoid concurrent Kùzu writes
                self._cmd_queue.put(("__teach_save__", self._teaching_name, list(self._teaching_steps)))
                self._stop_teaching()

        elif verb == "/query":
            if not arg:
                trace.write("[red]Usage: /query <cypher>[/red]")
            else:
                self._run_query(arg)

        elif verb == "/tools":
            from ..action.executor import get_executor
            tools = get_executor().list_actions()
            trace.write("[bold]Registered tools:[/bold]  " + "  ".join(tools))

        elif verb == "/memory":
            self._show_memory_stats()

        elif verb == "/wipe":
            self._confirm_wipe()

        elif verb == "/restart":
            self._restart_worker()

        elif verb in ("/status", "/refresh"):
            pass  # panes auto-update from events; this is a no-op refresh

        elif verb in ("/clear", "/cl"):
            trace.clear()

        else:
            trace.write(f"[red]Unknown command: {cmd}[/red]  Type [bold]/help[/bold] for a list.")

    # ── Teaching mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _start_teaching(self, name: str) -> None:
        self._teaching_name = name
        self._teaching_steps = []

        def _capture(event):
            self._teaching_steps.append({
                "action": event.data.get("action"),
                "parameters": event.data.get("parameters", {}),
            })

        self._teaching_subscriber = _capture
        subscribe(EventType.PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED, _capture)

        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write(
            f"[yellow bold]● REC[/yellow bold]  Recording [bold]{name!r}[/bold] — "
            "demonstrate the workflow, then type [bold]/done[/bold]"
        )

    def _stop_teaching(self) -> None:
        if self._teaching_subscriber is not None:
            get_event_bus().unsubscribe(EventType.PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED, self._teaching_subscriber)
            self._teaching_subscriber = None
        self._teaching_name = None
        self._teaching_steps = []

    # The actual save runs inside the worker (enqueued above) to avoid
    # concurrent Kùzu writes with the agent thread.

    # ── Live Kùzu query ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _run_query(self, cypher: str) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import get_kuzu_connection
            conn = get_kuzu_connection()
            rows = conn.execute(cypher)
            if not rows:
                trace.write("[dim](no results)[/dim]")
                return
            from rich.table import Table
            from rich.markup import escape
            table = Table(show_header=True, header_style="bold cyan", box=None)
            for col in rows[0].keys():
                table.add_column(str(col))
            for row in rows[:50]:  # cap at 50 rows in trace
                table.add_row(*[escape(str(v)) for v in row.values()])
            trace.write(table)
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Query error: {e}[/red]")

    # ── Memory stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _show_memory_stats(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import get_kuzu_connection
            conn = get_kuzu_connection()
            stats = {}
            for table, label in [
                ("Goal", "Goals"), ("Action", "Actions"),
                ("Session", "Sessions"), ("ElementCache", "Elements"),
                ("Preference", "Preferences"),
            ]:
                try:
                    rows = conn.execute(f"MATCH (n:{table}) RETURN count(n) AS c")
                    stats[label] = rows[0]["c"] if rows else 0
                except Exception:
                    stats[label] = "?"
            line = "  ".join(f"[bold]{v}[/bold] {k}" for k, v in stats.items())
            trace.write(f"[cyan]Memory:[/cyan]  {line}")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Memory stats error: {e}[/red]")

    # ── Wipe ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _confirm_wipe(self) -> None:
        from textual.screen import ModalScreen
        from textual.widgets import Button, Label
        from textual.containers import Vertical

        class WipeConfirm(ModalScreen):
            def compose(self):
                with Vertical(id="dialog"):
                    yield Label("⚠  Wipe the entire Kùzu database?\nThis cannot be undone.", id="q")
                    yield Button("Yes, wipe", variant="error", id="yes")
                    yield Button("Cancel", variant="primary", id="no")

            def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
                self.dismiss(event.button.id == "yes")

        def _after(confirmed: bool) -> None:
            if confirmed:
                self._do_wipe()

        self.push_screen(WipeConfirm(), _after)

    def _do_wipe(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)

        # 1. Cancel any running execution
        get_cancellation_token().cancel()

        # 2. Guard: check worker is not busy
        if self._worker and self._worker.is_alive():
            # Clear the queue and send shutdown sentinel
            try:
                while True:
                    self._cmd_queue.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                pass
            self._cmd_queue.put(None)
            self._worker.join(timeout=1.0)

            if self._worker.is_alive():
                trace.write(
                    "[red]Worker is still running (stuck in LLM call).[/red]  "
                    "Cancel first with [bold]Esc[/bold], then retry /wipe."
                )
                return

        # 3. Close Kùzu Database object (not just connection)
        try:
            from ..memory.graph.connection import KuzuConnection
            KuzuConnection._instance = None  # allow GC to close the DB
            import gc; gc.collect()
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[yellow]Warning: could not close Kùzu cleanly: {e}[/yellow]")

        # 4. Delete the DB directory
        from ..core.config import get_config
        db_path = get_config().kuzu.database_path
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(db_path, ignore_errors=True)
            trace.write(f"[green]Wiped {db_path}[/green]")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Failed to delete {db_path}: {e}[/red]")
            return

        # 5. Re-bootstrap Kùzu
        try:
            from ..memory.graph import _bootstrap
            _bootstrap()
            trace.write("[green]Kùzu re-initialized.[/green]")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.write(f"[red]Re-bootstrap failed: {e}[/red]")

        # 6. Start fresh worker
        self._start_worker()

    # ── Restart worker ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _restart_worker(self) -> None:
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)

        if self._worker and self._worker.is_alive():
            trace.write(
                "[yellow]Worker is still running.[/yellow]  "
                "Press [bold]Esc[/bold] to cancel, then retry [bold]/restart[/bold]."
            )
            return

        trace.write("[cyan]Restarting agent worker...[/cyan]")
        self._start_worker()
        trace.write("[green]Worker restarted.[/green]")

    # ── Actions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_cancel_execution(self) -> None:
        """Escape — soft-cancel current execution."""
        get_cancellation_token().cancel()
        pipeline_pane = self.query_one(PipelinePane)
        pipeline_pane._status = "CANCELLING"
        trace = self.query_one(TracePane)
        trace.write("[yellow]◼ Cancelling...[/yellow]")

    def action_clear_trace(self) -> None:
        self.query_one(TracePane).clear()

    def _show_error(self, msg: str) -> None:
        try:
            self.query_one(TracePane).write(f"[red]{msg}[/red]")
        except Exception:
            pass


def main():
    MeiTUI().run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## Task 5: Create Mei/cli/graph.py

```python
"""
Mei Graph Inspector — standalone read-only Kùzu viewer.

Run with:  py -m Mei.cli.graph

This is a POST-MORTEM tool. It opens the Kùzu database in read-only mode.
While the agent is running and holds the write lock, this tool will show
a "DB locked" banner and retry on keypress.

For live inspection while the agent is running, use /query inside the TUI.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Optional

import kuzu
from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.binding import Binding
from textual.widgets import (
    DataTable, Footer, Header, Static, TextArea, Tree
)
from textual.containers import Horizontal, Vertical

# Pull DB path from config rather than hardcoding it
def _db_path() -> str:
    try:
        from ..core.config import get_config
        return get_config().kuzu.database_path
    except Exception:
        return "data/kuzu_memory"


STARTER_QUERIES = [
    "MATCH (g:Goal) RETURN g.raw_command, g.stability_score, g.created_at ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (g:Goal)-[:ACHIEVED_BY]->(a:Action) RETURN g.raw_command, count(a) AS steps GROUP BY g.raw_command ORDER BY steps DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (p:Preference) RETURN p.pref_key, p.pref_value, p.category ORDER BY p.category",
    "MATCH (e:ElementCache) RETURN e.element_query, e.app_name, e.hit_count ORDER BY e.hit_count DESC LIMIT 20",
    "MATCH (s:Session) RETURN s.id, s.started_at, s.ended_at ORDER BY s.started_at DESC LIMIT 10",
]


def _open_readonly() -> Optional[kuzu.Connection]:
    """
    Open the Kùzu database in read-only mode.
    Returns None if the file lock is held by the agent.
    """
    try:
        db = kuzu.Database(_db_path(), read_only=True)
        return kuzu.Connection(db)
    except Exception as e:
        if "lock" in str(e).lower() or "cannot set lock" in str(e).lower():
            return None
        raise


class MeiGraph(App):
    """Standalone Kùzu graph inspector."""

    TITLE = "Mei Graph Inspector"
    SUB_TITLE = _db_path()

    BINDINGS = [
        Binding("r", "refresh", "Refresh", show=True),
        Binding("f5", "run_query", "Run query", show=True),
        Binding("ctrl+q", "quit", "Quit", show=True),
    ]

    CSS = """
    Screen { layout: vertical; }

    #top-row {
        height: 1fr;
        layout: horizontal;
    }

    #goal-tree {
        width: 40%;
        border: solid $primary;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    #right-col {
        width: 60%;
        layout: vertical;
    }

    #query-area {
        height: 8;
        border: solid $accent;
    }

    #results-table {
        height: 1fr;
        border: solid $primary;
    }

    #stats-bar {
        height: 1;
        background: $primary-darken-2;
        color: $text;
        padding: 0 1;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self._conn: Optional[kuzu.Connection] = None
        self._locked = False

    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        with Horizontal(id="top-row"):
            yield Tree("Goals", id="goal-tree")
            with Vertical(id="right-col"):
                yield TextArea(STARTER_QUERIES[0], id="query-area")
                yield DataTable(id="results-table")
        yield Static("", id="stats-bar")
        yield Footer()

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        results = self.query_one(DataTable)
        results.show_header = True
        self.action_refresh()

    # ── Refresh (tree + stats) ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_refresh(self) -> None:
        """[r] Reopen DB, rebuild tree, update stats."""
        # Close previous connection and DB object
        if self._conn is not None:
            try:
                self._conn.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._conn = None

        self._conn = _open_readonly()
        stats_bar = self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static)

        if self._conn is None:
            self._locked = True
            stats_bar.update(
                "⚠  DB locked — agent is running.  "
                "Press [bold]r[/bold] to retry, or use [bold]/query[/bold] inside the TUI."
            )
            tree = self.query_one("#goal-tree", Tree)
            tree.clear()
            tree.root.add_leaf("(DB locked — agent holds write lock)")
            return

        self._locked = False
        self._rebuild_tree()
        self._refresh_stats()

    def _rebuild_tree(self) -> None:
        if self._conn is None:
            return

        tree = self.query_one("#goal-tree", Tree)
        tree.clear()

        try:
            rows = self._conn.execute("""
                MATCH (g:Goal)
                OPTIONAL MATCH (g)-[:ACHIEVED_BY]->(first:Action)
                OPTIONAL MATCH p = (first)-[:NEXT_ACTION*0..20]->(a:Action)
                RETURN DISTINCT g.id AS gid, g.raw_command AS cmd,
                       g.stability_score AS stab, g.created_at AS ts,
                       a.tool_name AS tool, a.parameters_json AS params,
                       a.step_domain AS domain
                ORDER BY g.created_at DESC, length(p)
                LIMIT 100
            """)
        except Exception as e:
            tree.root.add_leaf(f"Query error: {e}")
            return

        # Group by goal
        goals: dict[str, dict] = {}
        goal_actions: dict[str, list] = {}

        for row in rows:
            gid = row.get("gid", "?")
            if gid not in goals:
                stab = row.get("stab")
                stab_str = f"{stab:.2f}" if stab is not None else "?"
                goals[gid] = {
                    "cmd": (row.get("cmd") or "")[:60],
                    "stab": stab_str,
                    "ts": (row.get("ts") or "")[:19],
                }
                goal_actions[gid] = []

            tool = row.get("tool")
            if tool:
                try:
                    params = json.loads(row.get("params") or "{}")
                except Exception:
                    params = {}
                goal_actions[gid].append((tool, params, row.get("domain", "")))

        # Build tree
        root = tree.root
        for gid, meta in goals.items():
            label = f"{meta['cmd']}  [stab={meta['stab']}]  {meta['ts']}"
            goal_node = root.add(label, expand=False)
            seen_tools = set()
            for tool, params, domain in goal_actions.get(gid, []):
                key = (tool, json.dumps(params, sort_keys=True))
                if key not in seen_tools:
                    seen_tools.add(key)
                    param_str = ", ".join(f"{k}={v!r}" for k, v in list(params.items())[:3])
                    goal_node.add_leaf(f"[{domain}] {tool}({param_str})")

    def _refresh_stats(self) -> None:
        if self._conn is None:
            return

        stats_bar = self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static)
        counts = {}
        for table, label in [
            ("Goal", "Goals"), ("Action", "Actions"),
            ("Session", "Sessions"), ("ElementCache", "Elements"),
            ("Preference", "Preferences"),
        ]:
            try:
                rows = self._conn.execute(f"MATCH (n:{table}) RETURN count(n) AS c")
                counts[label] = rows[0]["c"] if rows else 0
            except Exception:
                counts[label] = "?"

        line = "  │  ".join(f"{label}: {v}" for label, v in counts.items())
        stats_bar.update(f"  {line}  │  Press [r] refresh  [F5] run query  [Ctrl+Q] quit")

    # ── Query panel ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def action_run_query(self) -> None:
        """[F5] Execute the Cypher in the query area."""
        if self._locked or self._conn is None:
            self.query_one("#stats-bar", Static).update(
                "⚠  DB locked. Press [r] to retry."
            )
            return

        cypher = self.query_one("#query-area", TextArea).text.strip()
        if not cypher:
            return

        table = self.query_one("#results-table", DataTable)
        table.clear(columns=True)

        try:
            rows = self._conn.execute(cypher)
        except Exception as e:
            table.add_columns("Error")
            table.add_row(str(e))
            return

        if not rows:
            table.add_columns("Result")
            table.add_row("(no results)")
            return

        cols = list(rows[0].keys())
        table.add_columns(*[str(c) for c in cols])
        for row in rows[:200]:  # cap display at 200 rows
            table.add_row(*[str(row.get(c, "")) for c in cols])


def main():
    MeiGraph().run()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

    working_memory = get_working_memory()
    executor = get_executor()
    print(f"Executor ready: {len(executor.list_actions())} tools registered")

    emit(EventType.AGENT_STARTED, source="headless")
    start_pipeline()

    def text_input_thread():
        time.sleep(1)
        print("\n--- Headless mode (type commands, 'quit' to exit) ---")
        while True:
            try:
                cmd = input().strip()
                if cmd.lower() in ('quit', 'exit', 'q'):
                    print("Shutting down...")
                    os._exit(0)
                if cmd:
                    process_text(cmd)
            except Exception:
                break

    input_thread.start()

    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(0.1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass

    stop_pipeline()
    print("Mei stopped.")

The worker needs to handle the `__teach_save__` sentinel tuple that `_handle_slash /done` enqueues:

```python
def _agent_worker(self) -> None:
    from ..core.pipeline import process_user_command
    from ..action.context import ExecutionContext
    import time as _time

    while True:
        cmd = self._cmd_queue.get()
        if cmd is None:
            break

        # Teaching save — tuple sentinel
        if isinstance(cmd, tuple) and cmd[0] == "__teach_save__":
            _, name, steps = cmd
            try:
                from ..memory.graph.episodic import write_episode
                from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
                write_episode(
                    execution_id=f"teach_{int(_time.time()*1000)}",
                    session_id=get_working_memory()._session_id or "teach",
                    intent={"raw_command": name, "action": "taught", "target": None},
                    step_results=[{
                        "action": s["action"],
                        "parameters": s["parameters"],
                        "success": True,
                        "duration_ms": 0,
                        "data": {},
                        "method_used": "taught",
                        "step_description": s["action"],
                        "step_domain": "taught",
                        "step_expected_output": "",
                    } for s in steps],
                    success=True,
                    duration_ms=0,
                    stability_score=0.85,
                )
                emit(EventType.MEMORY_STORED, source="Teaching", name=name, steps=len(steps))
            except Exception as e:
                emit(EventType.ERROR, source="Teaching", error=str(e))
            continue

        # Regular command
        try:
            get_cancellation_token().reset()
            ctx = ExecutionContext.empty()
            from ..memory.working import get_working_memory
            session_id = get_working_memory()._session_id
            if session_id:
                ctx.set_variable("session_id", session_id)
            process_user_command(cmd, ctx)
        except Exception:
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            emit(EventType.ERROR, source="Worker", error=tb)

"""
Global soft-cancellation token for the MicroPlanner execution loop.

Usage:
    from Mei.core.cancellation import get_cancellation_token
    token = get_cancellation_token()
    token.cancel()        # called from TUI Escape binding
    token.reset()         # called at start of each new command
    token.is_cancelled    # checked in MicroPlanner between steps
"""
import threading


class CancellationToken:
    """
    Thread-safe cancellation flag backed by threading.Event.
    threading.Event is exactly this primitive — no hand-rolled lock needed.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._event = threading.Event()

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        """Signal cancellation. MicroPlanner checks this before each step."""
        self._event.set()

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Clear the flag. Call when a new command is submitted."""
        self._event.clear()

    @property
    def is_cancelled(self) -> bool:

"""
Global soft-cancellation token for the MicroPlanner execution loop.

Usage:
    from Mei.core.cancellation import get_cancellation_token
    token = get_cancellation_token()
    token.cancel()        # called from TUI Escape binding
    token.reset()         # called at start of each new command
    token.is_cancelled    # checked in MicroPlanner between steps
"""
import threading


class CancellationToken:
    """
    Thread-safe cancellation flag backed by threading.Event.
    threading.Event is exactly this primitive — no hand-rolled lock needed.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._event = threading.Event()

    def cancel(self) -> None:
        """Signal cancellation. MicroPlanner checks this before each step."""
        self._event.set()

    def reset(self) -> None:
        """Clear the flag. Call when a new command is submitted."""
        self._event.clear()

    @property
    def is_cancelled(self) -> bool:
        return self._event.is_set()


_global_token = CancellationToken()


def get_cancellation_token() -> CancellationToken:
    """Return the process-global cancellation token."""
    return _global_token

"""
TUI Event Bridge — connects the agent's EventBus to the Textual app.

Uses post_message() (thread-safe Textual API) to push agent events
to the TUI without polling or queues. Zero latency, no timer needed.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from textual.message import Message

from ..core.events import get_event_bus, Event

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from textual.app import App


class AgentEvent(Message):
    """Wraps an agent Event for delivery to Textual widgets via the DOM."""

    def __init__(self, event: Event) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.agent_event = event


class TUIEventBridge:
    """
    Subscribes to the global EventBus (subscribe_all) and posts each
    incoming event to the Textual app via post_message() — which is
    thread-safe and works correctly from agent worker threads.

    Usage:
        bridge = get_event_bridge()
        bridge.attach(self)   # call from MeiTUI.on_mount
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._app: App | None = None

    def attach(self, app: "App") -> None:
        """Call once from MeiTUI.on_mount after the app is running."""
        self._app = app
        get_event_bus().subscribe_all(self._on_event)

    def _on_event(self, event: Event) -> None:
        """Called from agent worker thread — posts to app's message queue."""
        if self._app is not None:
            try:
                self._app.post_message(AgentEvent(event))
            except Exception:
                pass  # app may be shutting down; ignore silently


_bridge = TUIEventBridge()


def get_event_bridge() -> TUIEventBridge:
    """Return the process-global event bridge."""
    return _bridge

"""
Pipeline pane — shows current execution tier, confidence, stability, status.

Updates on:
  MEMORY_PLAN_FOUND, MEMORY_PLAN_NOT_FOUND, TRANSCRIBE_COMPLETED,
  PLAN_COMPLETED, PLAN_FAILED, AGENT_STARTED, AGENT_STOPPED.

Note on message routing:
  Textual messages bubble UP the DOM. AgentEvent is posted to the App,
  which dispatches to panes explicitly via on_agent_event in MeiTUI.
  The on_agent_event method here is called directly by the App, not
  through Textual's normal event dispatch.
"""
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.text import Text
from textual.app import RenderResult
from textual.widget import Widget

from ...core.events import EventType
from ..event_bridge import AgentEvent


class PipelinePane(Widget):
    """Displays pipeline status, tier, confidence, and stability."""

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    PipelinePane {
        height: 100%;
    }
    """

    def __init__(self, **kwargs) -> None:
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self._status = "IDLE"
        self._command = ""
        self._tier = "-"
        self._confidence = "-"
        self._stability = "-"

    def render(self) -> RenderResult:
        status_color = {
            "IDLE":       "dim",
            "EXECUTING":  "green",
            "CANCELLING": "yellow",
            "FAILED":     "red",
            "CANCELLED":  "dim",
            "COMPLETED":  "green",
        }.get(self._status, "white")

        lines = Text()
        lines.append("Status:     ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"● {self._status}\n", style=status_color)
        lines.append("Command:    ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"{self._command[:40]}\n", style="white")
        lines.append("Tier:       ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"{self._tier}\n", style="cyan")
        lines.append("Confidence: ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"{self._confidence}\n", style="cyan")
        lines.append("Stability:  ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"{self._stability}\n", style="cyan")

        return Panel(lines, title="[bold]PIPELINE[/bold]", border_style="blue")

    def on_agent_event(self, msg: AgentEvent) -> None:
        """Called directly by MeiTUI.on_agent_event — not Textual dispatch."""
        event = msg.agent_event
        et = event.type

        if et == EventType.TRANSCRIBE_COMPLETED:
            self._command = event.data.get("text", "")[:40]
            self._status = "EXECUTING"
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_PLAN_FOUND:
            self._tier = str(event.data.get("tier", "?"))
            conf = event.data.get("confidence", 0.0)
            self._confidence = f"{conf:.4f}"
            stab = event.data.get("stability_score")
            if stab is not None:
                self._stability = f"{stab:.3f}"
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_PLAN_NOT_FOUND:
            self._tier = "3 (decompose)"
            self._confidence = "-"
            self._stability = "-"
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.PLAN_COMPLETED:
            self._status = "COMPLETED"
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.PLAN_FAILED:
            reason = event.data.get("reason", "")
            self._status = "CANCELLED" if reason == "cancelled" else "FAILED"
            self.refresh()

        elif et in (EventType.AGENT_STARTED, EventType.AGENT_STOPPED):
            self._status = "IDLE"
            self.refresh()

"""
Trace pane — live execution log with step status icons.

Updates on:
  PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED, PLAN_STEP_FAILED, PLAN_COMPLETED, PLAN_FAILED,
  MEMORY_PLAN_FOUND, MEMORY_PLAN_NOT_FOUND, TRANSCRIBE_COMPLETED,
  LLM_LOADING, LLM_LOADED, ERROR.

Uses rich.markup.escape on ALL user-derived text to prevent markup injection.
Called directly by MeiTUI.on_agent_event — not through Textual dispatch.
"""
from rich.markup import escape
from textual.widgets import RichLog

from ...core.events import EventType
from ..event_bridge import AgentEvent


class TracePane(RichLog):
    """Scrollable rich log of agent execution events."""

    DEFAULT_CSS = """
    TracePane {
        height: 100%;
    }
    """

    def on_mount(self) -> None:
        self.border_title = "EXECUTION TRACE"
        self.highlight = True
        self.markup = True

    def on_agent_event(self, msg: AgentEvent) -> None:
        """Called directly by MeiTUI.on_agent_event."""
        event = msg.agent_event
        et = event.type
        data = event.data

        if et == EventType.TRANSCRIBE_COMPLETED:
            text = escape(data.get("text", ""))
            self.write(f"\n[bold cyan]▶ Command:[/bold cyan] {text}")

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_PLAN_FOUND:
            tier = data.get("tier", "?")
            conf = data.get("confidence", 0.0)
            stab = data.get("stability_score", "-")
            self.write(
                f"[blue]  MemoryHit tier={tier} conf={conf:.4f} stab={stab}[/blue]"
            )

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_PLAN_NOT_FOUND:
            self.write("[dim]  No memory match — decomposing fresh[/dim]")

        elif et == EventType.PLAN_STEP_COMPLETED:
            action = escape(str(data.get("action", "")))
            params = escape(str(data.get("parameters", {})))
            method = escape(str(data.get("method_used", "")))
            self.write(
                f"  [green]✓[/green] [bold]{action}[/bold]"
                f"  [dim]{params}[/dim]  [dim]{method}[/dim]"
            )

        elif et == EventType.PLAN_STEP_FAILED:
            action = escape(str(data.get("action", "")))
            error  = escape(str(data.get("error", "")))
            self.write(f"  [red]✗[/red] [bold]{action}[/bold]  [red]{error}[/red]")

        elif et == EventType.PLAN_COMPLETED:
            dur = data.get("duration_ms", 0)
            self.write(
                f"[green bold]✔ PLAN COMPLETED[/green bold]  [dim]{dur:.0f}ms[/dim]"
            )

    MemoryPane {
        height: 100%;

        lines.append(f"{self._last_tier}\n", style="cyan")
        lines.append("Last stab:  ", style="bold")
        lines.append(f"{self._last_stability}\n", style="cyan")

        return Panel(lines, title="[bold]MEMORY[/bold]", border_style="blue")

        et    = event.type

        if et == EventType.MEMORY_SESSION_STARTED:
            self._session_id = data.get("session_id", "?")
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_SESSION_ENDED:
            self._session_id = "ended"
            self.refresh()

        elif et == EventType.MEMORY_PLAN_FOUND:
            self._last_tier    = str(data.get("tier", "?"))

            stab = data.get("stability_score")
            if stab is not None:
                self._last_stability = f"{stab:.3f}"
            self.refresh()
